Horse_Wide_Set_Eyes.description: With a pair of wide-set eyes, this horse possesses an enhanced field of vision and heightened perception, allowing it to detect potential threats from a distance, a trait that makes it a vigilant and reliable companion on the darkest of nights.

Goat_Horizontal_Pupils.description: The Goat_Horizontal_Pupils component endows the bearer with elongated, slit-like eyes reminiscent of a goat's, enhancing their perception to pierce through the shadows and granting an innate sense of balance that allows them to traverse treacherous terrain with ease, while also bestowing the ability to ignore any penalties from rough or uneven ground.

Camel_Lash_Shielded_Eyes.description: Embedded within the cephalon's head, these shielded eyes resemble the fierce gaze of a desert-dwelling camel, granting unparalleled vision and defense against blinding winds, while also bolstering the wearer's constitution, bestowing resilience and endurance in the harshest of environments.

Deer_Large_Docile_Eyes.description: These large, docile eyes, gleaming with an otherworldly charm, enhance the charisma and perception of the beholder, granting them the uncanny ability to charm and remain ever vigilant in the shadowy realms of the dark fantasy world.

Boar_Small_Beady_Eyes.description: Bristling with a keen awareness of their surroundings, the small boar's beady eyes pierce through the thickest underbrush, granting them an innate sense of danger and defense, though at the cost of a slightly diminished perception of the world beyond their immediate threat.

Rhino_Thick_Lidded_Eyes.description: Beneath the thick, bony ridges of the rhinoceros's lidded eyes, a layer of natural armor protects its vision from harm, granting it resistance to piercing attacks and the ability to block with its formidable brow.

Hippopotamus_Protruding_Eyes.description: Brimming with an eerie, otherworldly glow, the Hippopotamus_Protruding_Eyes component manifests as a pair of bulbous, translucent orbs that protrude from the forehead, granting enhanced perception and a disturbingly acute awareness of one's surroundings, while also bestowing the ability to breathe underwater, allowing for effortless traversal through aquatic domains.

Bison_Deep_Set_Eyes.description: Deep-set eyes, dark and piercing, bore into the soul with an unyielding gaze, their heavy brow providing a shield against the harshest of environments, granting the bearer a resilience to cold and a rugged constitution.

Zombie_Stag_Milky_Dead_Eyes.description: The Zombie Stag's milky dead eyes, a chilling beacon of the undead, emit an eerie glow that pierces through the darkest of nights, though their once-pristine vision has been clouded by the corruption of death, now offering a twisted perception that grants resilience against the venomous bites of their nightmarish kin.

Ghost_Horse_Glowing_Eyes.description: The spectral eyes of the Ghost Horse burn with an otherworldly glow, piercing through the veil of darkness and revealing the hidden currents of arcane energy that weave through the night, enhancing the rider's wisdom and perception to detect even the faintest whispers of magic.
